comment: The weather of the first dungeon: dust motes that hang in the air (D-187, D-202). The motes start across the view, they drift sideways at a crawl, and they never fall. The scene light falls on them, so a mote shows inside a pool of torchlight and stays dark outside one (D-183). The view is 640 by 360 art pixels, and each x and y comes from its north-west corner (D-842). PR-17 gives the first places their own weather (D-520).
